title: Canonical section coordinates on the point coefficient unit
statement: Fix a finite-field datum, a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$; use the actual completed integral coefficient sheaf and point section functor of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. The integralSection map from the regular lifted $\mathcal O_E$-module to sections of the completed coefficient sheaf is $a\mapsto$ the constant completed section $a$. Define integralSectionsUnit as the canonical isomorphism from the derived integral fibre of the constant coefficient object to the regular lifted $\mathcal O_E$-module in degree zero: use the exact-functor degree-zero comparison followed by the inverse of this section map, which is invertible because the completed constant sections at $s$ are $\mathcal O_E$, the integral coefficient-unit identification of [lem-zl-constant-geometric-stalk-unit]. Define rationalRegular from extension of scalars of the regular $\mathcal O_E$-module to the regular lifted $E$-module by the tensor multiplication $e\otimes a\mapsto ea$. These are the actual section and multiplication coordinates, with the displayed carrier lifts.
